import numpy as np
base = np.array([[0.7, 0.1j], [-0.1j, 0.9]], dtype=np.complex128)
direction = np.array([[0.2, 0.04], [0.04, -0.1]], dtype=np.complex128)
def _preserving_call(function, *arguments):
    snapshots = [(argument, argument.copy()) for argument in arguments if isinstance(argument, np.ndarray)]
    result = function(*arguments)
    for argument, before in snapshots:
        assert np.array_equal(argument, before), "input arrays must remain unchanged"
    return result
assert np.allclose(_preserving_call(transformed_modal, base, direction, np.array([[2, 0], [1, 4]], dtype=complex), direction * 0.2), target)
